initial_failure_retained.subsequent_login_page_error: WeChat identity must be bound to a verified account
initial_failure_retained.root_cause: The Development provider derived openid directly from each ephemeral wx.login code, so the same simulator received a different local identity on its next login.

fix.scope: Only develop mini-program builds talking to the Development WeChat provider use a locally persisted random synthetic device identifier. Production builds still submit the original ephemeral code to jscode2session.

page_verification.driver: wechatide 0.3.9 supported automation against actual page controls

bind_screenshot.observed: Account page shows 当前微信已绑定 after the actual bind button was tapped.

final_screenshot.observed: Home page shows the same masked resident identity and resident-only navigation after the actual WeChat login button was tapped.

page_verification.raw_network_buffer_reason: The supported Developer Tools buffer contains authorization headers and token bodies. Only redacted method/path/status/request_id facts from the API structured log were retained.

boundary: This proves the current local Development provider and mini-program page flow only. Production jscode2session, real credentials, target-domain allowlisting and formal release acceptance remain unverified.
